title: Claude background-task frames during an open host attempt bar a pre-effect transient error from its automatic retry
outcome: It is settled, on evidence about Claude Code's producer semantics, whether a background task's system frames (task_notification, task_started, task_updated, background_tasks_changed) arriving inside an open host attempt leave that attempt safe to replay. The automatic retry follows that decision, with a test for each subtype after `started` and the prompt-hook barrier as the negative control.
acceptance: Claude background-task frames during an open host attempt bar a pre-effect transient error from its automatic retry is done
